note: Chinese cloud GPU rates that NO live lane can reach. Tencent, Huawei and Volcengine publish GPU pricing only behind signed-AccessKey APIs and on China-facing consoles denominated in CNY; computecomparison.com/provider/tencent-cloud and /huawei-cloud both return empty stubs (checked 2026-08-29), and getdeploying.com does not list them at all. These rows are CITED, not fetched: each carries the article it came from, the date it was read, and a re-verify date. They merge into gpu-pricing.json tagged confidence=indicative AND seeded=true, so every surface can say 'cited 2026-08-29' rather than implying a live fetch. Alibaba Cloud is NOT here — it is reachable live from the aggregator provider page and rides that lane instead.

provenance.fx_note: CNY figures converted at 7.25 CNY/USD, a rounded planning rate observed 2026-08-29 — NOT a dealt rate. Chinese-cloud rows therefore carry TWO layers of approximation (the cited range midpoint and this conversion) and must never be presented as quotes.
sources: https://www.promptquorum.com/local-llms/alibaba-cloud-vs-tencent-cloud-gpu-ai-2026 — Tencent Cloud TI A100 80GB CNY 7.5-10/hr; Alibaba Cloud PAI CNY 8-12/hr (read 2026-08-29)

export_control_note: Chinese clouds largely do not offer H100/H200/B200 to domestic customers: US export controls put H20 and A800-class parts in that market instead. A comparison that silently substitutes an H100 rate for a Chinese provider would be comparing a part that cannot be bought there. Rows below name the accelerator actually on sale.
